events.summary:
* WHAT...One to two feet of inundation above ground level
expected in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways.

* WHERE...Ocean and Coastal Ocean.

* WHEN...From 6 AM Thursday to 3 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...At this level, widespread roadway flooding occurs in
coastal and bayside communities and along inland tidal
waterways. Many roads become impassable. Some damage to
vulnerable structures may begin to occur.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The most severe and impactful high tide
will be with Thursday morning's high tide, where major tidal
flooding is possible. Further minor to moderate tidal flooding
is possible with Thursday Night's high tide. Significant beach
erosion is possible. Breaching of sand dunes may occur.

events.region: Surry; James City; Newport News; Isle of Wight
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, up to one foot of
inundation above ground level expected in low-lying areas near
shorelines and tidal waterways. For the Coastal Flood Warning, 2
to 4 feet of inundation above ground level expected in low-
lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways.

* WHERE...Surry, James City, Newport News, Isle of Wight.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 6 AM EST
Thursday. For the Coastal Flood Warning, from 6 AM to 5 PM EST
Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Major flooding may cause extensive inundation and
flooding of numerous roads and buildings resulting in a
significant threat to property and life. Water will be 2 to 3
feet or more above ground level in some areas. Flooding may
extend inland from the waterfront and shoreline flooding homes,
businesses and isolating some neighborhoods. Numerous roads may
become impassable under several feet of water and cars
submerged.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 10 to
17 feet expected in the surf zone. For the Coastal Flood
Warning, 2 to 4 feet of inundation above ground level expected
in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways.

* WHERE...In Maryland, Maryland Beaches. In Virginia, Accomack and
Northampton.

* WHEN...For the High Surf Advisory, from 10 AM this morning to
7 AM EST Friday. For the Coastal Flood Warning, from 5 AM to 5
PM EST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Major flooding is expected resulting in extreme
inundation. Water will be 2 to 4 feet or more above ground level
in flooded areas. Numerous homes and businesses could be
flooded. Many roads across the area may become impassable for an
extended period of time causing many neighborhoods to become
flooded and isolated. Life threatening flooding will extend well
inland from the waterfront and shoreline. Should evacuations
become necessary, follow the advice of local officials for
evacuation information.

businesses. Flooding will extend inland from the waterfront
